[[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4, Hard Mode) |hidden = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Bow}}''' - Shoots an arrow at a tower, stunning it for a few seconds. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Hunter''' was an enemy that only appeared in [[Eggy Island]] as part of the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. It appeared in easy mode and hard mode with the same amount of health. It had average speed in easy mode and above average speed in hard mode. The '''Hunter''' could shoot arrows at towers, stunning them for a while. ==Appearance== The '''Hunter''' had a smile face. It had sky blue skin and its torso and legs were green. It had a quiver strapped on its back with arrows stashed in it. It also wielded a longbow to shoot arrows at towers. ==Strategy== *Due to its low health, [[Sniper]]s and [[Pyromancer]]s can be used to defeat this with ease. **In hard mode, it is also recommmended to use the [[Pyromancer]] to slow down the '''Hunter''' due to its higher speed. *In hard mode, the [[Rocketeer]] may be useful as the '''Hunter''' normally spawns behind a horde of [[Zombegg]]s and [[Sugrawr]]s. *You can use cheap towers, such as the [[Scout]], to distract the '''Hunter''' away from your main attacking towers. **When the '''Hunter''' shoots its arrow, it also stops moving, giving you more time to attack it with other towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NoobFace.png|'''Hunter's''' face. }} ==Trivia== *This was the only enemy that appeared in both easy and hard mode, in [[Eggy Island]], that had the same amount of health in both modes. *This enemy resembled the [[Archer|Holiday Archer]] quite greatly. They both had similar animations and sounds. ==Update History== *'''6 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.9|Release v1.9.0]] **'''Hunter''' added. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **'''Hunter''' removed. {{EggyIsland|[[Eggsplosive]]
